root_causes: The pinned AnythingLLM digest was recorded by the ImageStream but its registry manifest no longer existed after registry storage migration.
The participant deployment requested 1 CPU while the certified seat envelope reserves 665 millicores for the complete seat.
The public tunnel had drifted to one replica pinned to gnr2, so terminal WebSocket recovery depended on one worker.
Preferred anti-affinity did not guarantee that two tunnel connectors used different workers.
